notes:
v4.6.16 — Per-model AI cost · AI usage charts · Algorithmic moderation

✨ NEW
• Per-model Make Bot credit cost (Via APEX). Each model has its own price (Llama 1◊ · Haiku 3◊ · Gemini Flash 2◊ · Llama-3.3-70B 4◊ · Gemini Pro 8◊ · GPT-4o 12◊ · Sonnet 4.5 20◊ · GPT-5 25◊ · Opus 4.7 40◊). The Make Bot tab badge now reflects the selected model's price. Bringing your own API key (Anthropic / OpenAI / Groq / Gemini directly) still costs 0 APEX credits — only Via APEX is metered.
• AI USAGE platform-wide donut charts on the web dashboard home. Live SVG donuts split by CREATOR (which AI built each bot) and RUNNER (which AI each bot calls at runtime). Sourced from /web/api/ai-stats which aggregates marketplace bots + the credits-ledger recent-generation log.
• Algorithmic moderation bot: server-side hourly cron (server/auto_moderation.py) scans every public marketplace bot for (a) Jaccard ≥ 0.90 similarity to an earlier-submitted bot from a different owner → copyright flag; (b) META.asset_type / META.ai_used / META.requirements mismatched against the actual code → 'misdeclared' flag. Idempotent. Admin endpoints at /admin/moderation/flags + /admin/moderation/run to view/clear/trigger.

💄 Includes v4.6.14's UI minimalism pass + v4.6.15's universe-dropdown fix.
